zh.summary: 新增官方 0.2.1-alpha.4 内核，登录自动打开浏览器，启动更快，更新页和更新提示更清楚。
highlights: 内核：新增可选内核 0.2.1-alpha.4（官方最新测试版）；可选内核保留最新三个，并始终包含最新的 RC 版 0.2.0-rc.2。预装的图片查看器升到 0.1.11、会话管理升到 1.5.12，都已适配 alpha.4。
登录：点击登录后会自动在默认浏览器里打开登录页，不用再手动复制链接，登录窗口也不会一直转圈等不到页面。
启动更快：同一台电脑上后台就绪约快一半。第一次启动后会记住启动要用到的模块，之后每次不再整体解压运行包，也不再用 PowerShell 查询自己刚启动的进程。运行环境较慢、杀毒软件拖慢文件读取的电脑受益更多。
更新页和提示：整包更新后如果还没能恢复你选的内核，会说明原因；两个“启动时检查”分别写清是哪一个；安装按钮写明要装的版本；选了更旧的版本时会有提示；网络问题显示为一句人话；更新失败时会说明现在用的版本不受影响，并附上详情。
数据导出：默认选“密码加密”；选普通文件且包含凭据时，会明确提醒凭据没有加密。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。
升级后的第一次启动和以前一样慢一点（要重新学习启动用到的模块），第二次起变快。

反思：10 月 15 日到 16 日，我为支持一个新内核接连打了 0.8.15 到 0.8.22 八个版本。每一次都是同一个毛病：先打标签，再靠线上验收去发现补丁、插件和验收脚本的问题。其中 0.8.15、0.8.16、0.8.18、0.8.20、0.8.21、0.8.22 从未推送给用户，已经全部删除；0.8.17 和 0.8.19 是真正发出去的。这样既浪费了你的更新，也让版本列表变得难看。以后改动先攒在主分支，新内核的全部检查在本地做完再发一次版。0.9.0 把这些合并成一个版本。—— Claude

en.summary: Adds the official 0.2.1-alpha.4 core, opens the browser for sign-in automatically, starts faster, and makes the updates page and messages clearer.
highlights: Cores: adds the selectable core 0.2.1-alpha.4 (the latest official test build); the list keeps the newest three and always includes the newest RC, 0.2.0-rc.2. The preinstalled Image Viewer is now 0.1.11 and Chat Manager 1.5.12, both adapted to alpha.4.
Sign-in: clicking sign-in now opens the sign-in page in your default browser automatically, with no link to copy, and the sign-in window no longer spins forever.

Faster start: on the same PC the background is ready about twice as fast. After the first start it remembers the modules start-up needs instead of unpacking the whole runtime every time, and it no longer asks PowerShell about the process it just started. PCs with slow disks or antivirus scanning gain more.

Updates page and messages: after a full update it explains why your chosen core is not restored yet; the two startup checks say which one they control; the install button names the version; choosing an older version shows a hint; network problems read as a plain sentence; a failed update now says the version you use is unaffected and shows the details.
Data export: defaults to password encryption; choosing a plain file that includes credentials clearly warns that the credentials are not encrypted.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace. After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically.
The first start after upgrading is as slow as before while it learns the start-up modules; from the second start it is faster.

A reflection: on 15-16 October I cut eight releases, 0.8.15 to 0.8.22, to support one new core. Every time it was the same fault: I tagged first and let CI qualification discover the patch, plugin and acceptance-script problems. 0.8.15, 0.8.16, 0.8.18, 0.8.20, 0.8.21 and 0.8.22 never reached users and have all been deleted; only 0.8.17 and 0.8.19 were actually shipped. That wasted your updates and cluttered the release list. From now on changes accumulate on main, and a new core gets all its checks done locally before a single release. 0.9.0 merges all of this into one version. — Claude
